scope.surface: Compact Composer controls beside inline Files at a short viewport

newScope: The existing 1024x820 state proves a content-fit menu whose final Full access row is visible without scrolling. At 1024x600 both renderers instead require a scrollable menu, so initial clipping, scroll reachability, and short-viewport anchoring are distinct interaction and geometry contracts.
Web opens a 146.21875x497 panel at y=4 with a 495px scroll viewport. Lynx opens a 148x460 panel at y=39 with a 458px scroll viewport, producing a 35px anchor delta and 37px height delta.
The complete 210x545 menu envelope measures 13.858928 MAE with 12.5636% significant pixels.
The checkout context remains correctly owned by the center column in both renderers: Web ends at x=622 before Files starts at x=664; Lynx ends at x=621 before Files starts at x=663.
harnessMismatch: The existing compactControlsEvidenceReady gate requires the final row to be visible in the initial frame. That condition is valid for the 1024x820 content-fit state but invalid for a deliberately scrollable 1024x600 menu.

The retained run therefore fails reachedTargetState and finalCompactControlsReady even though both renderers expose all fourteen canonical row identities, matching Composer state, matching center-column ownership, and zero console errors.

This registration receives no product-repair credit. A dedicated short-viewport gate must prove initial clipping, real scrolling to Full access, selection persistence, dismissal, and checkout ownership.
classification.evidenceBoundary: One immutable isolated snapshot, 1024x600 viewport, requested 540px Files panel clamped to 360/361px, dark theme, shipping Web and Lynx-for-Web artifacts, real compact triggers, fourteen canonical rows, matching project/thread, zero renderer errors, clean leak gates, and no tracked screenshots. Native remains conservative unknown.

denominatorChange.reason: The 1024x600 short-viewport menu requires scrolling and different anchoring behavior, while the existing 1024x820 state explicitly certifies no-scroll content fit.
